recipes.name: The Naco inspired by Kim Possible
instructions: Combine: avocados, chopped red onion, crushed cloves of garlic, lemon juice, about cumin, chopped jalapeño, and salt and pepper to taste. Mix using a fork until desired consistency. Place in a bowl and put cling wrap directly on top of the guacamole and refrigerate until ready to use. - 2 avocados - ½ red onion chopped, separated - 2 cloves garlic separated - ½ juice from a lime - 2 tsp cumin - ½ jalapeños chopped, separated - Salt - Pepper

In a blender, combine: jalapeño, red onion, garlic, a small handful of cilantro, and small tomatoes that are stemmed, cut in half, and cored. Blend for about 15 seconds. Season with salt and pepper, cover with cling wrap, and refrigerate until ready to use. - 4 small tomatoes - ¼ red onion chopped, separated - 2 cloves garlic separated - ½ jalapeños chopped, separated - handful of cilantro - Salt - Pepper

In a medium pot on medium high heat, combine butter and all purpose flour and mix until flour smell has dissipated. Slowly whisk in whole milk until consistency is smooth, and then add shredded cheddar cheese (white or yellow will do). - 1 tbsp butter - 1 tbsp all purpose flour - 1 cup whole milk - 4 cups shredded cheddar cheese
Once you’ve added the cheese, add canned diced chilis and tomatoes (drained). Mix to combine for your queso. - ½ can diced chilis and tomatoes

On a rimmed baking sheet, cover with tortilla chips, then shredded cheese and queso (about ½ the pot) followed by another layer of chips, shredded cheese, and queso. - Tortilla chips - For The Queso - shredded cheddar cheese
Also add some sliced jalapeños and then place in a preheated oven at 400°F. Cook for about 20 minutes or until golden and crispy. - ½ jalapeños chopped, separated

Remove some nachos and chop them into bite-sized pieces. Place on a flour tortilla, cover with guacamole, salsa, and sour cream. - Soft flour tortillas - Sour cream - For The Guacamole - For The Salsa
